name: TwinDesk
description: All your computers and your phone/iPhone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux , Android, Web and ios / ipados . Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and no shared network needed.

latest_release.name: TwinDesk v3.0.0 : Now on iPhone, iPad and any browser with Twindesk Web
latest_release.body:
## TwinDesk 3.0: now on iPhone, iPad and any browser

https://twin-desk.vercel.app

![TwinDesk 3.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/main/.github/assets/v30-banner.jpg)

The biggest TwinDesk release so far, and the first new major version. TwinDesk now has **a native app for iPhone and iPad**, **TwinDesk Web** for any device with a browser (nothing to install), and **phones that pair with each other**: Android to Android, iPhone to iPhone, and Android to iPhone. The computers get a **Glass look**, **AirPlay on Windows and Linux**, **Tailscale**, and **five languages on every app**.

### ⬇️ Download

| Device | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** (Intel / AMD) | [`TwinDesk-Setup-3.0.0.exe`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-Setup-3.0.0.exe) |
| **Windows** (ARM) | [`TwinDesk-Setup-3.0.0-arm64.exe`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-Setup-3.0.0-arm64.exe) |
| **Mac** (Apple silicon, M1 and later) | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0-arm64.dmg`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0-arm64.dmg) |
| **Mac** (Intel) | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0-x64_Intel.dmg`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0-x64_Intel.dmg) |
| **Mac** (Homebrew) | `brew install --cask inukaasith/twindesk/twindesk` |
| **Linux** (any distro) | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0-x86_64.AppImage`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0-x86_64.AppImage) |
| **Linux** (Debian / Ubuntu) | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0-amd64.deb`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0-amd64.deb) |
| **Linux** (Arch) | [`twindesk-bin-3.0.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/twindesk-bin-3.0.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst) |
| **Android** | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0.apk`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0.apk) |
| **Android** (full: notification access, SMS, Accessibility) | [`TwinDesk-3.0.0-full.apk`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk-3.0.0-full.apk) |
| **iPhone and iPad** (sideload) | [`TwinDesk.ipa`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.0.0/TwinDesk.ipa) |
| **Any browser** | Turn on **TwinDesk Web** on a computer, then type `twindesk.local` |

Already have TwinDesk? The in-app updater picks the right file for your computer. Update every device you pair: 3.0 still talks to 2.5, but the new features switch on only when both sides have 3.0.

> **Windows:** the installers aren't code-signed yet (signing is on its way). If SmartScreen stops it, choose **More info › Run anyway**.
> **iPhone and iPad:** the IPA is unsigned. Install it with SideStore, AltStore or any signing tool, which signs it with your own Apple ID. An App Store release is what [sponsoring](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/blob/main/SPONSOR.md) pays for.

---

### 📱 TwinDesk for iPhone and iPad

![iPhone and iPad](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/main/.github/assets/v30-iphone.jpg)

A native SwiftUI app with the Android app's pages, and an iPhone is a phone on the computer like any other.

- **The computer's screen on the iPhone or iPad**, mirrored or as a second display, with touch, a touchpad mode, and the **Apple Pencil as a pen** with pressure, tilt and eraser.
- **Share Screen**: the whole iPhone screen in a window on the computer, every app, like presenting in a video call. Or Screen Mirroring to the computer's AirPlay receiver.
- **Files both ways** on fx2 (four parallel ranges, hashed as they stream), **Send to Computer** in the share sheet, and the computer's folder in the Files app.
- **Photos on the computer**: its Photos page shows the iPhone's photos and videos, newest first.
- **Clipboard** both ways, the **computer's notifications**, its **sound** on the iPhone, the iPhone's **camera** and **microphone*
